Healthcare artificial intelligence company Innovaccer Inc. today announced that it has expanded its Gravity Voice AI agents with Grok Voice, the speech-to-speech model from Elon Musk’s artificial intelligence company SpaceXSI, formerly xAI. The integration is aimed at the routine calls that make up much of a health system’s phone traffic, such as booking a visit, […]
